rationale: The file contains two transaction functions (`Deposit` at L155 and `Withdraw` at L189) that both call `time.Now().String()` and assign the result to `tx.Timestamp`. This timestamp is then marshaled into JSON and written to the ledger via `stub.PutState()` at L169 and L203 respectively. Since `time.Now()` returns non-deterministic wall-clock time that varies across endorsing peers, different endorsers will produce different ledger writes, causing consensus failure. This is a direct C1 TIME_NOW vulnerability where the time source influences a ledger write.
